FN-2JV2RKK-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 84
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/19/2026
Senate Bill 84 as introduced would codify existing practice of the Alabama Department of
Public Health to set and enforce the standards for the preparation of meals served at facilities
operated by the Department of Correction or cities or counties. The provisions of this bill would
not directly affect state or local funding.
